reason: The specification is a faithful, complete and correct formulation of the idea, and I could not construct a defect on any of the review axes. GRAPH SIDE (train split only): A is the symmetric co-occurrence count over the 24556 Stage-2 training items with a zero diagonal from the adjacent pairs (i_t, i_{t+1}); D = ceil(mean degree over all n_train items with isolated items counted at degree 0); N(i) = the top-D neighbours by count with ascending-id ties; sim_ij = |N(i) cap N(j)| / sqrt(deg_i deg_j) in [0,1] because |N(i)| = min(D, deg_i); coh_i = (1/deg_i) sum_{j in N(i)} sim_ij <= 1, and the spec keeps the idea's truncated-neighbourhood / full-degree normalisation instead of silently smoothing it, declaring the resulting item-dependent deg^(-3/2) factor and noting that only the rank, never the magnitude, enters the cost. rho_i = (#{j in P: coh_j < coh_i} + 0.5 #{j in P: coh_j = coh_i, j < i}) / (|P| - 1): the counts run over P = the items with a training edge, the item is excluded from its own counts, the support is [0,1] (unique top = 1; a g-way top tie reaches (|P|-1-0.5(g-1))/(|P|-1), which the spec states correctly), edge-less items take rho = 0.5 and take no part in the counts, and the |P|-1 denominator is the idea's own (its text is already amended), putting the rank on the same [0,1] scale as the sigmoid strata. CACHE: float32 length 24556, built once, frozen, gathered by item id. COST / LEVEL 1: x = exp_0^c(r) and y = exp_0^c(a) with c = 1, R_c = 1/sqrt(c) = 1, via LIFT(v) = tanh(sqrt(c)||v||) v / (sqrt(c)||v||); MOBIUS substitutes X = -x, so (-x)(+)y = ((1 - 2c<x,y> + c||y||^2)(-x) + (1 - c||x||^2)y)/(1 - 2c<x,y> + c^2||x||^2||y||^2), and DIST = (2/sqrt(c)) artanh(min(sqrt(c)||(-x)(+)y||, 1-1e-6)). The symbolic surface (xy = -(x0y0+x1y1), numerators multiplied by -x0) and the executable (mobius called with -x, +2c inside) agree with each other and with the definition; d_c(x,x) = 0 and the c -> 0 limit is 2||x-y||, both checked, and d_c(0, lift(v)) = 2||v|| is consistent with the framework's tangent-norm convention. Offset O_ik = beta R_c (1 - |rho_i - s_k|) in [0, beta] with R_c = 1, and C_ik = D_k - O_ik, so the cost is minimal where the stratum matches the rank, which is the idea's sign. beta = m/R_c with m = the MEDIAN of D_{i,k1(i)} (the distance to the codeword the balanced assignment actually chose) measured once at epoch 0 step 0 in the beta = 0 pass over the pooled step-0 batch (four ranks x 1023 = 4092 distances), divided by R_c = 1 and FROZEN; the population is declared, so m is one global quantile, the same quantity the idea asks for and not a new estimator. C goes into the baseline's Sinkhorn unchanged, which exponentiates it itself (exp(-C/epsilon)) exactly once with the baseline's epsilon and iteration count and the baseline's marginals (row sums 1, column sums B/K1); k1 = argmax of the plan, ties to the smallest index. LEVEL-1 RECONSTRUCTION: p_i = one_hot(k1_i) + P_i - stop_grad(P_i) is exactly the framework's canonical straight-through x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach() with x = P and x_q = one_hot(k1), its forward value is the RAW codeword a_{k1} (= sum_k p_ik a_k), r_next = r - a_{k1} uses the UNLIFTED codeword, and levels 2 and 3, the residual recursion, the loss (baseline recon + baseline commit) and the optimiser are untouched. GRADIENT PATH is stated for every operator: the argmax carries none and the STE is what carries it; P stays differentiable so reconstruction -> P -> C -> |rho_i - s_k| -> sigmoid(alpha_k) trains the 256 strata (unconditionally), and the codebook and encoder receive gradient through d_c; c, R_c, beta and rho are declared frozen with no gradient. No extra loss, no plain argmin, no use of val/test/future behaviour, no sweep. DIMENSIONS all check: D_k, O_ik, C_ik, P_ik are B x K1; k1 and rho_i are B; s_k and alpha_k are K1; e1 and r_next are B x D; the executable's broadcasting matches. SWITCHES do what they claim: BEHAVIOUR_OFF sets the offset identically to 0 (C = D_k) while keeping the Poincare distance, the balancing and the strata, giving plain hyperbolic-cost balanced quantisation with no behaviour information; GEOMETRY_OFF sets c = 0 so LIFT is the identity and DIST = 2||x-y|| (the true c -> 0 limit of d_c), keeps the frozen R_c = 1 and the beta measured in the curved configuration so the two arms differ in the distance and in nothing else, and the strata are still initialised and used - exactly the idea's two ablations, neither of which is trained this round. The stratum order is declared to be an initialisation and not a maintained invariant, which is what the idea says. Nothing is missing (incomplete/missing are empty and every computation the idea names is present), nothing is ambiguous in a way that changes the result, and no scale, sign or limit is wrong.
